test: G2 ranking test (hold-out, Top-10 relevance vs popularity baseline)

split.method: seeded random 80/20 of CSV ratings (no timestamps in Goodbooks-10k, so no temporal split); streamed ratings always in train

relevance_definition: book rated 4 or 5 stars by the user in the TEST set
candidate_universe: 10,000 books minus books the user rated in TRAIN (seen-item exclusion); ALS scores its top 200 candidates per user, then the 10 best unseen

eligible_denominator.note: metrics are averaged over the eligible users only

serving_model.note: the model write_recs.py wrote to MongoDB
